description: Full state of one launchpad launch: curve price, raise vs graduation target, settlement mode, fee split, and — when COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY is set — this wallet's curve position (shares, invested COOK, current sell value, what it already claimed) plus pending creator fees if it created the launch. Pass `quoteCook` to preview how many tokens a buy of that size would get. A `status` of `ended` means trading closed but the pool is not settled on-chain yet — nothing can be traded, and only a Fair-mode refund can be claimed (the claim settles the pool itself). Read-only.

quoteCook.description: optional COOK amount to quote a buy for, e.g. 10

ref.description: the token mint or the launchpad pool address (either works)

name: get_launchpad_token
